env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: On first turn, scans the workspace and injects a compact project summary
env_context_strategy.note: The bootstrap summary is on by default, and the model also navigates with the read_file/search/find_files tools. RAG over an external corpus via BM25 plus hashed vectors runs once an index exists.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Tool results capped at 4k chars, mid-turn eviction drops old results when context grows too large, and semantic compression summarizes history instead of dropping it.

observation_format.note: Playwright web_fetch extracts text; the README mentions no screenshots. src/session/images.js exists but was not opened.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: SmallCode parses tool calls from JSON, YAML, XML, Hermes format, Liquid AI's `<|tool_call_start|>[func(kw='val')]<|tool_call_end|>` markers (lfm2.x), or plain text.
tool_call_format.note: Model profiles select the tool format (native/hermes/json/xml/text). The Liquid pythonic-call format is mapped to code_as_action as the closest value, but it is parsed, not executed.

tool_count.evidence_quote: | `contract_assert_skip` | Mark an assertion skipped (out of scope) |
